title: El castillo: los alumnos con sus modelos
description: docs/castle.md § Bestiary. The castle's pupils drawn from their own figures (just character-3d, Meshy) where they have one, the palace minion where not yet: La Chivata, El Repetidor, El Empollón, La Delegada and Los Gemelos of the first year, El Castigado of the second and its run at the party, and a room's pupils patrolling the first floor. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.foe = kind => ui.live.foes.find(f => f.kind === kind); window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); };
